target_customer: Corporate legal departments that draft contracts and documents
problem: Drafting legal documents by copy and paste is slow and error prone. AXDRAFT turns documents into a Q&A drafting flow with approvals, data validation and e-signature.
business_model: B2B SaaS for corporate legal teams

founders.name: Oleg Zaremba
founders.role: Co-founder, led engineering, product and QA
founders.background_notes: YC bio: 2x YC alumnus; co-founded AiSDR in 2023 with his brother.

founders.name: Yuriy Zaremba
founders.background_notes: YC bio: grew AXDRAFT from 0 to 2M through founder-led sales; 2x YC alumnus.

technical_complexity.rationale: A drafting algorithm that turns any document into Q&A with multilingual support including Chinese and Japanese, per Onit coverage, is standard software with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Template and workflow integration gives some lock-in but contract drafting tools were plentiful.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Onit acquired AXDRAFT on 2020-12-17 as its third acquisition, running it as a subsidiary, terms undisclosed.

market_need_then: Company claimed 45 corporations used it and cut drafting time by up to 90 percent (YC description). Independent demand data not found.

branding.domain_note: axdraft.com; blog at blog.axdraft.com announced the Onit deal. The company holds a US trademark for AXDRAFT filed March 2020, registered May 2021 (trademark record).

brand_strength.rationale: No source shows press, community or founder commentary about the brand itself, so no brand strength can be shown.

outcome_analysis: AXDRAFT was founded in Kyiv in 2017, joined YC in Winter 2019 and reached about 2M in revenue through founder-led sales per its founder's YC bio. Onit bought it in December 2020 to add document automation to its contract lifecycle suite. Price was not disclosed, so the outcome cannot be sized.
notes: axdraft.com did not resolve in this session.
